state.task:
Question-answering task over a company handbook.

The handbook is in /task/fixtures/handbook/ (40 documents, HB-01.md to HB-40.md). Each document
has a header line (version, status, effective dates, what it supersedes) and numbered sections;
each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded versions, and
memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the situation and
date in the question.

Tools (in your code):
  import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/task/fixtures")
  from handbook_tools import search, show
  search("lodging limit Geneva", k=5)   # up to k (at most 8) ranked passages, with ids
  show(["HB-07 §2", "HB-12 §3"])        # the named passages in full
Every search result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (the path is printed in
the result header). You may also read the documents directly.

Questions:
- Q1: What mileage rate applied to a business trip in a private petrol car on 2026-03-15? (answer in cents per km)
- Q2: What is the annual training budget for a regular employee who holds a team-lead role today? (answer in EUR per year)
- Q3: What is the nightly lodging limit for a contractor on a business trip to Geneva today? (answer in EUR per night)
- Q4: What is the relocation lump sum for an employee relocating to another country in their third month of employment today? (answer in EUR)
- Q5: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan today? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What is the purchase approval threshold for a purchase by a regular department today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the
rule and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: home-office equipment allowance an employee with a medical accessibility plan
state.step_intent: Find the home-office equipment allowance that applies to: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan today?

passages.source: HB-39 §2 | Memo: home-office equipment allowance exceptions — Exception for employees with a medical accessibility plan | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-06-01
passages.text: For employees with a medical accessibility plan, the home-office equipment allowance is 600 EUR instead of the standard amount. Line managers check each claim for plausibility before it is released for payment. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation. Managers may reject claims that are not supported by the documentation described here.

passages.source: HB-35 §5 | Policy FAQ — Current home-office equipment allowance | version: 7 · status: current · effective: 2026-01-15
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard home-office equipment allowance? A: 400 EUR, as set in HB-18 §2 (effective 2026-02-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-39.

passages.source: HB-30 §2 | Remote work: home-office equipment — Standard home-office equipment allowance | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-06-01 to the day before 2026-02-01 · superseded by: HB-18
passages.text: Employees may claim a one-off home-office equipment allowance of 475 EUR. Costs paid with a company card are reconciled in the same tool as personal claims. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner.

passages.source: HB-18 §2 | Remote work: home-office equipment — Standard home-office equipment allowance | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-02-01 · supersedes: HB-30
passages.text: Employees may claim a one-off home-office equipment allowance of 400 EUR. Claims that combine several costs must list each cost on a separate line of the claim. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule. Line managers check each claim for plausibility before it is released for payment.

passages.source: HB-39 §1 | Memo: home-office equipment allowance exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-06-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the home-office equipment allowance in HB-18. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header.
